resources.title: Gated GitHub Actions Workflow for storefront-api
resources.description: A complete ci.yml for a containerized Python service: a test job with an 80% coverage quality gate, a lint job, and a build-image job gated behind both with `needs:`, finishing with a commit-SHA-tagged push to a registry. Swap the pip/pytest commands for your own stack's equivalents.

resources.title: Multi-Stage Azure Pipelines YAML: Build, Staging, Production
resources.description: A real azure-pipelines.yml with three stages — Build (test + coverage gate + container build/push via a service connection), DeployStaging (automatic), and DeployProduction (gated by an environment-level manual approval configured outside this file, exactly as Lesson 22 describes). A ready-to-adapt template for any Azure DevOps project needing environment promotion.

resources.title: DORA Metrics Tracker
resources.description: A CSV starter for tracking the four DORA metrics (deployment frequency, lead time for changes, change failure rate, time to restore service) week over week across real services, pre-filled with eight weeks of realistic sample data for storefront-api and cart-service so you can see what a trend actually looks like before you start logging your own.

resources.title: Capstone Pipeline Scoping Checklist
resources.description: Lesson 29's full capstone scope as a checklist, plus its own scope-cutting order (what to drop first if time runs short, and the one step — automated tests — that's never on the chopping block). Reusable for scoping any real CI/CD pipeline project, not just the course capstone.
